method: Every count is taken from the shipped rows on disk or a fresh fetch of the pinned revision. Nothing is taken from a README, an HF card badge, a lock-file assertion, or a STATUS sentence. Unverifiable values are the string 'unverified', never an estimate.

leakage_policy: Leakage is a five-tuple (unit definition, absolute target coverage, floor, concentration, provenance class) and is never collapsed to a scalar or compared across banks whose memory unit differs. Floors are labelled exhaustive or sampled. Provenance settles contamination; concentration settles lexical tractability; they are independent axes.

achievable_floor.question: the lowest question->target concentration compatible with the question remaining answerable and uniquely identifying
achievable_floor.shape_dependence: state-churn 0.9134, file-symbol-grounding 2.1717, task-resumption 1.965 -- a shape-uniform bar is itself a defect
achievable_floor.recorded_roughness: small sample, single generator model, agent-judged uniqueness; treat as an order-of-magnitude floor, not a constant
achievable_floor.consequence: bars must be calibrated against a measured achievable floor BEFORE preregistration; three of our bars have been set below what reality achieves
